The number of candidates trained in Batch 2 in 2001 was what percentage more than the number of candidates trained in Batch 5 in 2005?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Number of candidates trained in Batch 2 in 2001 = 144

Number of candidates trained in Batch 5 in 2005 = 90

Difference = 144 - 90 = 54

Required % = 54/90 × 100

⇒ 60%

**∴ Required answer is 60%**
